question: Should OpenClaw permanently add a top-level `auth` namespace solely as an alias for the shipped `models auth list` command?
rationale: This is a public CLI taxonomy and compatibility choice rather than a missing implementation detail, because the listing behavior already exists and is documented under `models`.

options.title: Keep the canonical models path
options.body: Decline the duplicate root namespace and address discoverability through help, suggestions, or documentation.

options.title: Sponsor a root auth namespace
options.body: Approve `auth` as a permanent public command family and require shared registration plus live proof for the final shape.

recommendation.title: Keep the canonical models path
recommendation.body: Decline the duplicate root namespace and address discoverability through help, suggestions, or documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the canonical auth-list surface and have the strongest direct history on this exact command.
